↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on July 1st, 2004.

I see that this has brought up Hammy Hamilton’s “Money Musk” in the recordings list, but the tune on that album is the afore-mentioned “Little Bag Of Spuds”. I think there might be an error in the track listing - the 2 tunes are easily confused.

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on July 1st, 2004.

Hammy Hamilton already made some mistakes in the track listing. He plays “The Fair Haired Lass” as “The Dark Haired Lass,” “Miss Thornton” as “The House on the Hill.” I’m not surprised if he mixed up some more tunes.

Anything For John Joe, X:9

As played in sessions in the Kings Arms in Bangor North Wales in the late 1970s. Introduced there by the trio “Quilty” with a “minor surprise” at the end. It was usually played three times through rather than twice as written here.
Quilty were Ian Stevenson, Mandolin; Eamon ? Guitar, Mandolin and Vocals; Malcom ?, Bouzouki and Vocals. And I think one of them played Bodhran. Ian Stevenson is fairly well known. I’d be happy to hear from anyone who knows or remembers the last names of the other two. Eamon had nlack hair and a splendid moustache and Malcom had red hair and beard.

↳ Posted by Bibso on January 22nd, 2026.
